title: MemoryExportsCreateResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "export_id": string, "chunk_count": int, "total_bytes": int, "bundle_digest": string, "counts": { "subjects": int, "records": int, "candidates": int, "profiles": int, "reflections": int, "receipt_summaries": int } }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.exports.create (§7.29): NOT_AUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND, INVALID_INPUT, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
